article.title: Partícula coloquial/reportativa дескать
article.part: Pragmática y registro — Прагматика и регистр
article.chapter: Partículas coloquiales y pragmática — Разговорные частицы и прагматика

claims.summary: Paducheva (2011, pp. 13–15) analyzes дескать as marking quoted/attributed content; in example (1), it occurs in indirect speech and ties the proposition to Vasya as the cited person.

The cited person is responsible for the attributed proposition, while the current speaker is responsible for presenting it as that person’s content; the source also documents an interpreted gesture as attributed content in example (7).

Distance/disagreement is not a mandatory invariant meaning of дескать; Paducheva distinguishes the clear attribution component from optional disagreement or distancing that depends on contextual support.

locator.description: Article pp. 13–15, abstract and section “Частица дескать”; example (1), Вася сказал, что он, дескать, сам тебе позвонит; definition components (a)–(b).

links.notes: El texto completo de la fuente primaria fue leído; el ejemplo se reproduce con atribución y glosa acotadas.

locator.description: Article pp. 14–16: analysis of examples (1)–(3), distinction between content attribution and speaker responsibility; p. 16, example (7), махнула мне рукой — иди, дескать.

links.notes: El ejemplo gestual se formula como interpretación atribuida, no como cita verbal literal.

locator.description: Article pp. 15–16, discussion of examples (2)–(3): source states that distancing/disagreement may be contextual and that attribution is the component supported with greater certainty; conclusion pp. 18–19.

links.notes: Se retiró la afirmación general de ironía/escepticismo y se conserva únicamente el matiz condicionado por contexto.
